When task_id is supplied, based_on_revision and based_on_phase are required.

operation_id.description: Optional caller operation id. Retries return durable receipts without replaying effects. Use a new id for a new event; a changed payload with the same id is refused.

operation_recovery.description: Explicit sender-scoped recovery of this same operation_id. CAS against operationRevision with an audit reason. Current ACL/task revision must still pass. Resumes known missing steps, or confirms delivery from a matching real dispatch; inflight or unconfirmed external effects are refused.

message.description: Self-contained message for the target. Required for info/action; optional for a decision whose blocked_action, reason and evidence already carry the request.

delivery.description: Required. info = notify only; action = wake a peer/downward target; decision = wake the direct superior for a blocked decision.

reason.description: Required for action and decision: why the target must act now.

blocked_action.description: Required for decision: the exact action waiting on the superior.

evidence.description: Required for decision: evidence proving the block or pending decision.

based_on_revision.description: Required with task_id: the exact revision returned by team_task_get immediately before this message.

based_on_phase.description: Required with task_id: the exact phase returned by team_task_get immediately before this message.

privilege_request_id.description: Optional for decision: privilege request awaiting tier-0 review.

urgency.description: Critical is reserved for safety or data-loss risk.

wake.description: Deprecated compatibility alias: wake:true maps to delivery:"action". A missing delivery is otherwise refused.

schemas.name: interrupt_agent
schemas.description: Interrupt one member’s current turn while preserving its pending inbox. Tier 0 may interrupt anyone; a tier 1 lead may interrupt only its own members. Same-level peers can talk but never interrupt each other.

schemas.name: list_agents
schemas.description: List active Team members visible to you. Frozen members are hidden by default; set include_frozen:true only to inspect or restore them. Group isolation is enforced.

include_frozen.description: Include frozen members. Defaults to false.

schemas.name: todo_write
schemas.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. Mark each todo `completed` as soon as it is done.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

schemas.name: get_goal
schemas.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

schemas.name: create_goal
schemas.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

schemas.name: update_goal
schemas.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

schemas.name: exit_plan_mode
schemas.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

schemas.name: subagent_fork
schemas.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

schemas.name: list_subagent_models
schemas.description: Discover LLM routes for subagents without changing the current Agent. Call with no arguments to list registered providers, with `provider` to list its advertised models, or with `provider` and `model` to inspect that exact model and its reasoning efforts. Catalog membership is advisory: an adapter may accept an unlisted model id. Use the returned ids with a delegation tool's `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` fields.

provider.description: Registered LLM provider id. Omit to list providers.

model.description: Exact model id to inspect. Requires provider; omit to list that provider's advertised models.

schemas.name: subagent
schemas.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles. Child LLM selection is optional. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use configured child defaults and inherit compatible missing values from the parent Agent. Supply `provider` and `model` together after using `list_subagent_models` to inspect advertised routes and efforts. Changing the effective route without naming an effort uses the selected model's default effort.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

provider.description: LLM provider route for the child. Supply together with model; omit both to use configured child defaults or inherit the parent route.

model.description: Model id interpreted by provider. Supply together with provider; omit both to use configured child defaults or inherit the parent route.

reasoning_effort.description: Adapter-owned reasoning effort for the effective child route. Omit to inherit a compatible configured/parent effort or use a newly selected model's default.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

schemas.name: spawn_teammate
schemas.description: Create one named, durable teammate. Tier 0 may create tier 1 (a group lead, or the single independent verifier); a tier 1 group lead may create tier 2 members until the configured Team quota is reached. Tier 2 members cannot spawn.

role.description: Standing identity to dispatch: lead/verifier/member load the pre-written identity file and pin the tier and group for you; custom is the escape hatch where you write the whole prompt yourself. Defaults to custom.

description.description: Short description shown in the roster. Defaults to the role label for a built-in role.

prompt.description: For a built-in role: only the task brief — goals, deliverable, acceptance criteria, write scope. The standing identity, duties, and prohibitions are supplied by the role file. For role:"custom": the complete prompt.

context.description: fresh starts without Lead history; fork inherits completed Lead turns. Defaults to fresh.

tier.description: Requested tier. Defaults to 1 for tier 0 callers and 2 for tier 1 callers.

group.description: Group id. Tier 0 defaults it to the member name; the independent verifier group is "verifier".

provider.description: Optional LLM provider route for the new member.

model.description: Optional LLM model id for the new member.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for the new member.

schemas.name: team_room_open
schemas.description: Open or reuse a durable Team room. Rooms are the default non-waking channel for peer coordination.

depends_on.description: Parent room ids whose rounds must close before this room can start a round. Group rooms infer level:1 automatically when it exists.

host.description: Optional host override. Only tier 0 may use it with replace_host:true.

replace_host.description: Replace the host of an existing room. Tier 0 only.

schemas.name: team_room_join
schemas.description: Join a durable room as the current Team member.

member.description: Optional member to add; defaults to yourself.

schemas.name: team_room_next
schemas.description: Start one of at most three fixed-order rounds in a room. The host is always included as a participant; when members are omitted or the host is not named, the host is appended last. Each participant gets one main turn plus at most one short clarification.

schemas.name: team_room_post
schemas.description: Post a fact, proposal, risk or question to a durable room without waking recipients.

round_id.description: Active round; defaults to the room round.

schemas.name: team_room_read
schemas.description: Read the compact room snapshot: current round, decisions, unresolved points, evidence, next speaker and pending escalations. Raw transcript is omitted unless explicitly requested.

include_messages.description: Include the raw transcript; defaults to false.

schemas.name: team_room_timeout_recover
schemas.description: Record one durable room-timeout repair event. Retry the current speaker, wake/replace the host for an awaiting-close round, or tier-0 force-close after the bounded close grace. This never reassigns tasks or wakes the whole Team.

action.description: Retry a speaker, wake/replace the close host, record a stall, or force-close an impossible round.

new_host.description: replace-host: a room member that accepts close responsibility.

summary.description: force-close: optional round summary; defaults to a deterministic recovery summary.

schemas.name: team_room_close
schemas.description: Close the active room round and persist a compact summary.

force_close.description: Tier 0 only. Close despite missing speakers when every missing speaker is frozen, or when the room holds a member that cannot be seated in this room kind and the round is therefore impossible to finish.

waived_members.description: Exact members waived by a forced close; must be listed in the waivable set the runtime derives.

force_close_reason.description: Audit reason required for a forced close.

schemas.name: team_room_decide
schemas.description: Record a room decision and its rationale without waking the hierarchy. Cross-group decisions must name every affected group lead in required_confirmations; the decision remains proposed until all of them confirm with team_room_confirm.

required_confirmations.description: Affected group leads. A single-member room may omit this for the host-confirmed compatibility path.

schemas.name: team_room_confirm
schemas.description: Confirm a proposed Room decision as one of its named affected group leads. The decision becomes effective only after every required lead has confirmed. This does not wake the hierarchy.

schemas.name: team_room_resolve
schemas.description: Resolve one previously recorded unresolved room item with a concrete outcome. The room host or tier 0 only. This keeps stale items from remaining open after downstream work lands.

text.description: Exact unresolved text when resolving a legacy or id-less item.

resolution.description: Concrete outcome or evidence proving the item is resolved.

schemas.name: team_escalate
schemas.description: Escalate one unresolved, evidence-backed decision. This is the only ordinary collaboration action that wakes a superior.

urgency.description: Critical may be used for an immediate safety or data-loss risk.

schemas.name: team_escalation_resolve
schemas.description: Resolve an escalation after its decision has been recorded. The target or tier 0 closes the wake episode only when every escalation in it is resolved.

schemas.name: team_escalation_list
schemas.description: Read durable escalations with category, urgency, target, summary and decisionNeeded. Open escalations are returned by default; wake-dead-letter rows are marked automated so they do not masquerade as human decisions.

schemas.name: team_wake
schemas.description: Compatibility alias for send_message(delivery:"action"). Wake one exact Team target for a message that must cause action now. Upward decision wakes must use send_message(delivery:"decision") or the team_wake_superior alias. When task_id is supplied, based_on_revision and based_on_phase are required; stale snapshots are refused. A pending identical sender/target wake is coalesced.

target.description: Exact Team member name, or lead where the sender is allowed to reach it.

message.description: Self-contained actionable message for the target.

reason.description: Why the target must act now instead of receiving a quiet message.

based_on_revision.description: Required with task_id: the exact revision returned by team_task_get immediately before this wake.

based_on_phase.description: Required with task_id: the exact phase returned by team_task_get immediately before this wake.

urgency.description: Critical is reserved for safety or data-loss risk.

schemas.name: team_wake_superior
schemas.description: Compatibility alias for send_message(delivery:"decision"). Wake your direct superior for a decision that is actually blocked on them. A tier-2 member reaches only its own group lead; a tier-1 lead reaches tier 0. Include the blocked action, reason and evidence. When task_id is supplied, based_on_revision and based_on_phase are required; stale snapshots are refused. A pending wake for the same sender/target is coalesced.

message.description: Optional decision summary. The canonical send_message(delivery:"decision") form may omit it because blocked_action, reason and evidence are the required payload.

blocked_action.description: The exact action waiting on the superior.

reason.description: Why this cannot be resolved inside the group or by a normal quiet message.

evidence.description: Evidence proving the block or pending decision.

based_on_revision.description: Required with task_id: the exact revision returned by team_task_get immediately before this wake.

based_on_phase.description: Required with task_id: the exact phase returned by team_task_get immediately before this wake.

privilege_request_id.description: Optional privilege request awaiting tier-0 review.

urgency.description: Critical is reserved for safety or data-loss risk.

schemas.name: team_privilege_request
schemas.description: Request a one-turn fail-closed bypass. Tier 1/2 members may request it for themselves only, with the blocked action, reason and evidence. Tier 0 reviews. Approval activates on the requester next wake and ends with that turn. If approval arrives while the requester is already running, it must not retry the blocked action in that turn; it takes effect only after the current turn ends and the member is woken again.

blocked_action.description: The exact action currently refused by a fail-closed gate.

reason.description: Why this action is required and why the normal scope/plan/provider path cannot unblock it.

evidence.description: Commands, refusal text, paths or IDs proving the block.

requested_scope.description: Optional narrow description of the one-turn bypass requested.

schemas.name: team_privilege_review
schemas.description: Tier-0 review of a one-turn privilege request. Approve or reject with a reason. Approval activates on the requester next wake and ends with that turn. If approval arrives while the requester is already running, it must not retry the blocked action in that turn; it takes effect only after the current turn ends and the member is woken again.

schemas.name: team_privilege_status
schemas.description: Read privilege requests visible to the caller. Members see their own; tier 0 sees all.

schemas.name: team_plan_propose
schemas.description: Create the durable execution plan for a task. Worktree setup and execution are refused until a lead approves it. An approved/rejected/blocked plan may be replaced explicitly with replace_approved:true after its active lease ends. Recovery path A (work can finish under the current scope): (1) finish the task and record exact commit_sha plus evidence, (2) call team_task_update(action:"complete") while this lease is active, (3) release this lease as completed, (4) call team_plan_propose with replace_approved:true and replace_reason, (5) acquire the replacement lease before editing again. Recovery path B (scope must change while work is in flight): (1) release or cancel the active lease, (2) call team_plan_propose with replace_approved:true and replace_reason to replace the plan with the corrected scopes, (3) acquire the replacement lease before editing again. Use status:"cancelled" only when the work is intentionally abandoned.

replace_approved.description: Replace an existing approved/rejected/blocked plan. Requires replace_reason and no active task lease.

replace_reason.description: Why the prior plan must be replaced; required with replace_approved:true.

schemas.name: team_plan_approve
schemas.description: Approve a proposed execution plan. Group leads approve plans contained in their group; cross-group plans require tier 0.

schemas.name: team_plan_get
schemas.description: Read the durable plan and its approval state.

schemas.name: team_dispatch_status
schemas.description: Read dispatch lifecycle and run lease state without waking anyone.

schemas.name: team_dispatch_update
schemas.description: Advance one durable dispatch lifecycle row from the member that owns it or from tier 0. This never wakes a recipient.

schemas.name: team_control_status
schemas.description: Read the compact durable Team control-plane snapshot for dashboards and recovery decisions.

schemas.name: team_provider_resume
schemas.description: Clear a durable provider block after the operator has restored credentials or quota. Tier 0 only.

schemas.name: team_compaction_reconcile
schemas.description: Tier-0 bookkeeping repair for milestone compaction jobs. Retires jobs whose milestone revision can no longer be proven complete, so stale pending jobs cannot fold a later milestone. It never folds context and never changes a live milestone.

schemas.name: team_run_lease
schemas.description: Acquire, heartbeat or release the one active execution lease for the current member.

schemas.name: team_evidence_record
schemas.description: Record a reproducible command, output, screenshot or resource scan in the durable evidence ledger.

schemas.name: team_acceptance_packet
schemas.description: Submit one aggregated acceptance packet. Permission: group-acceptance requires a tier-1 group lead, verifier-review requires the independent verifier, final-acceptance requires tier 0. A task already beyond the packet phase is accepted without phase rollback.

meta.description: Caller-defined packet metadata. packetVersion, revision, supersedes and contentDigest are platform-injected; see docs/agent-team-packet-meta-contract.md for the digest input.

schemas.name: team_member_reparent
schemas.description: Tier 0 transfers an existing tier-2 member to a replacement tier-1 lead in the same group. The override is persisted and changes message, interrupt, milestone and merge authority without rewriting the member session lineage.

schemas.name: wait_agent
schemas.description: Rarely needed and NEVER used to wait for a Room turn. When a Room is open, obey team_room_read.waitAction: stop means end the turn and let the system handoff wake you. This tool never wakes inactive members and returns noProgress immediately when no other member is running or provisioning. A return from this call, or the absence of one, is never evidence that a member is stuck.

timeout_ms.description: Wait duration in milliseconds, from 10000 through 3600000. Defaults to 30000.

schemas.name: freeze_member
schemas.description: Freeze or restore one member. A frozen member is a distinct state: it neither sends nor receives messages, cannot spawn or be interrupted, and is never cold-resumed by a delivery attempt. Tier 0 only.

schemas.name: set_member_route
schemas.description: Change a live member’s LLM provider/model/reasoning effort. The switch takes effect on that member’s next step. Tier 0 only.

schemas.name: team_milestone
schemas.description: Declare, tick and read the MILESTONE: the stage you can finish before your next task, plus the check that proves it done. Ticking it is what makes the runtime fold your context at a real task edge instead of cutting a task in half, so declare one early. Only you can set or tick YOUR OWN milestone; a superior and a peer may read it. action=list defaults to your own.

action.description: set declares or replaces your milestone, done ticks it and arms the compaction, list reads milestones you are allowed to see.

stage.description: action=set: the stage, e.g. "deliver and verify one user-visible capability". Must be finishable before your next task.

done_when.description: action=set: the command or check that proves it done, e.g. "run the project focused acceptance command and confirm PASS".

expected_done_when.description: action=done: echo the active done_when. Required when the proof was set or replaced within the last two minutes; a mismatch is refused.

target.description: action=list: read this member instead of yourself. Must be a member you are allowed to read.

schemas.name: team_worktree_setup
schemas.description: Lay out one member’s git worktree on its integration branch, so two members can never overwrite each other’s files. Tier 0 lays out its group leads, a group lead lays out its own members, and the verifier lays out its own DETACHED (read-only) checkout. On an existing stale worktree this MERGES the requested base into the branch; it never resets or rebases. If a conflict must be resolved without a lease, pass conflict_strategy plus both pinned full commit SHAs; this is the bounded sync channel used to break the acquire/commit deadlock.

task_id.description: Task whose plan has been approved.

repo.description: Repository directory the worktrees live under. Defaults to the caller session repository cwd.

base.description: Base branch or commit. Defaults to main unless the approved plan explicitly names a fresher base; stale group branches are never selected implicitly.

conflict_strategy.description: Explicit conflict resolution for a stale member branch: base keeps the requested base side; worktree keeps the member side. Requires expected_head and expected_base.

expected_head.description: Full 40-character member branch SHA observed before the conflict resolution.

expected_base.description: Full 40-character requested base SHA observed before the conflict resolution.

schemas.name: team_merge
schemas.description: Merge one branch back, as a tool with an approval. A group lead merges its own member into the group branch; tier 0 merges a group branch into main and must have a verifier clearance on that exact commit. A conflict is never auto-resolved: the unmerged paths are reported and the decision escalates to the branch owner.

target.description: Member whose branch is merged: a member for a group lead, a group lead for tier 0.

task_id.description: Task whose approved plan and evidence authorize this merge.

source.description: Explicit merge source. commit_sha merges the task card commit; branch_head merges the current source branch tip after proving it descends from that task commit. Defaults preserve the historical tier behavior: commit_sha for member-to-group, branch_head for group-to-main.

repo.description: Repository directory the worktrees live in. Defaults to the caller session repository cwd.

allow_source_ancestor.description: Explicitly allow a member-to-group merge to consume the exact task commit when the source branch tip has advanced. Defaults to false so stale card pointers fail closed.

ignore_untracked.description: Allow untracked files in the source/destination worktrees. Tracked modifications always remain blocking.

allowed_untracked.description: Exact untracked paths to allow in the source/destination worktrees. Other untracked paths and all tracked modifications remain blocking.

schemas.name: verifier_report
schemas.description: Publish one aggregated issue table. The independent verifier group only. Every issue must cite evidence that distinguishes the broken state; "nothing to report" is not a review. The table is written under the configured report directory and every group lead is notified with the path. A report clears exact commits only when its issue table contains no blocker or major; condition, minor, and nit findings do not suppress clearance.

name.description: Short report name, sanitized to [a-z0-9-_]. Becomes <name>.md in the report directory.

commit.description: Commit hash this verdict was produced against. Required to clear a branch for merge into main; reports with blocker or major do not write clearance keys.

cleared_commits.description: Additional exact commits this report clears, such as both the task commit and the group-branch head.

evidence.description: The command, file, or output that distinguishes the broken state.

schemas.name: team_task_create
schemas.description: Create one pending task with an explicit deliverable kind and an optional owner. Use the returned id verbatim; never infer the next id from a numeric sequence. discussion/review tasks use no write scopes and close with evidence; edit tasks require write scopes and the plan/commit gate.

description.description: Complete task details and acceptance criteria.

kind.description: discussion/review produce evidence without writes; edit produces tracked file changes.

blocked_by.description: Task ids that must complete first. Use boardId:taskId for a cross-board dependency.

dependency_phase.description: Dependency release threshold. Defaults to accepted; completed selects content completion without waiting for final acceptance.

write_scopes.description: Advisory workspace-relative file or directory prefixes this task expects to modify.

owner.description: Optional member name to assign in the same create mutation. Group leads may assign only their own group members or themselves.

board.description: Target board: global, level, group, or an exact board id such as group-proto or level-1. Defaults to global. Tier 0 may read every exact board; the verifier may read group boards read-only; other roles remain restricted to their own board.

schemas.name: team_task_list
schemas.description: List tasks on one board, including readiness, owner, revision, blockers, and write-scope warnings.

view.description: Optional compact decision view; default full. Compact is not completion evidence.

taskIds.description: Optional exact task ids within the authorized board.

changed_since.description: Return tasks updated strictly after this epoch-millisecond timestamp.

snapshotRevision.description: Optional exact control-plane revision; a changed snapshot is refused.

owner.description: Optional member-name filter; use unowned for tasks without an owner.

limit.description: Number of rows, 1 through 100. Defaults to 50.

board.description: Board to read: global, level, group, or an exact board id such as group-proto or level-1. Defaults to global. Tier 0 may read every exact board; the verifier may read group boards read-only; other roles remain restricted to their own board.

schemas.name: team_delivery_check
schemas.description: Check the board before declaring anything delivered. Lists every task that is not completed and, for each, whether its owner has already TICKED its milestone. Use verdict to filter; ownerless reference tasks are counted separately from actionable work. Tier 0 only.

verdict.description: Optional verdict filter for the open list.

schemas.name: team_task_get
schemas.description: Read the complete latest value of one task before changing or executing it.

view.description: Default full. Compact is a decision projection, not completion evidence.

board.description: Board to read: global, level, group, or an exact board id such as group-proto or level-1. Defaults to global. Tier 0 may read every exact board; the verifier may read group boards read-only; other roles remain restricted to their own board.

schemas.name: team_task_reconcile
schemas.description: Tier-0-only bookkeeping repair for a stranded REFERENCE task. It may complete only by linking to an already completed same-Team task that carries the exact commit and evidence; it never fabricates evidence or bypasses an execution gate.

source_task_id.description: Completed group-board task whose delivery this reference task represents.

board.description: Target board: global, level, group, or an exact board id such as group-proto or level-1. Defaults to global.

schemas.name: team_task_update
schemas.description: Compare-and-set one task action using the latest revision. Tier 0 may reassign any task; a group lead may reassign a task in its own group to one of its tier-2 members when the current owner is not running or the task is dependency-blocked and cannot be in flight. A group lead may also repair write_scopes on an unplanned own-group task when its owner is inactive and no run lease is active; plan-controlled scopes still require replacing the plan. reopen also recovers rejected/cancelled/expired phases. bind_fix repairs the commit/evidence pointers of a completed card without changing its phase or status. The global board accepts mutations from tier 0 only.

expected_revision.description: Current task revision used as the CAS precondition.

action.description: Task transition to apply. admin_close is a tier-0-only audit recovery for stranded global reference cards. bind_fix is a narrow completed-card ledger repair.

phase.description: Next durable task phase for advance_phase.

blocked_by.description: Complete blocker list for set_dependencies; boardId:taskId selects a cross-board task.

dependency_phase.description: Dependency release threshold for set_dependencies. Defaults to accepted; completed releases when each dependency status is completed.

commit_sha.description: Exact commit SHA produced by the task owner when completing it. bind_fix accepts null for a completed card that has no commit.

evidence_ids.description: Durable evidence ids proving the completed task.

owner.description: Member name for Lead-only reassign; omit to unassign.

force_complete.description: Tier 0 recovery for a global edit card whose owner is inactive. Requires force_complete_reason, exact commit_sha and evidence.

bind_fix_reason.description: Audit reason required with action:"bind_fix". The action changes only commitSha and evidenceIds on a completed task.

reopen_reason.description: Required with action:"reopen"; stored on the task as lastReopenReason and lastReopenAt.

reason.description: Alias for reopen_reason when action is "reopen".

board.description: Target board: global, level, group, or an exact board id such as group-proto or level-1. Defaults to global.

schemas.name: team_v12
schemas.description: Agent Team v12 aggregate control/read tool. Use it for runtime facts, capability gates, task contracts, ready queues, run leases, Room recovery, inbox acknowledgement, compaction state, evidence reuse, merge recovery, context packs, timelines and replay fixtures. Omit action to return compact runtime facts. leases shows the caller's own run leases; tier 0 may inspect any member and a group lead may inspect its own group through input {member}. waiting_list returns active tickets by default; input {includeClosed:true} also returns closurePolicy, closedReason, closedAt and closedBy; use input {ticketId,taskId,offset,limit} for exact or paged reads. failure_memory_status inspects one call signature; failure_memory_clear requires action_fingerprint plus reason and evidence. For inbox_ack, call inbox_list first and pass either the exact top-level wake_id or inbox_id; bulk/all acknowledgement is not supported.

schemas.name: context_manage
schemas.description: Read or CAS-update private/scoped non-authoritative memo objects and a next-boundary context view. Defaults to shadow. Exact context locators only; summaries require a completed task source. This tool cannot change Team task/lease/evidence authority.
